message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a Disney Princess jewelry tower with toy jewelry. It is a set of toy items for imitative role play, so I classified it as a toy set in heading 9503.

The candidate subheadings are:
- 9503.00.0073 is "Other toys; reduced-size models; puzzles... Toys representing animals or non-human creatures"? I'm not certain of this one.
- 9503.00.0071 is "Other toys, put up in sets or assortments" in the older schedule. After the 2007 revisions, 9503.00.00 was subdivided into numbers such as 9503.00.0073 ("Other" toys, "Other"). The code 9503.00.0071 does not match the current schedule.
- 9503.00.0073 covers "Other: Other toys" and is a plausible fit.

Because the set contains several toys, it is classified as a set under GRI 3(b). The container has a mirror and acts as storage, but the set's essential character is the toy dress-up items. The usual CBP result for this kind of item is 9503.00.0073, I believe, though 9503.00.0090 is also possible. I am going with 9503.00.0073.
